decision.explanation: Q01 is broadly similar to C06 (bowed_rotor): an approximately 2.02× frequency shift aligns the principal spectral and modulation families, while RMS, envelope level and crest factor remain unusually close. C03 is also similar after nearly the same shift, but C06 is better supported by the joint absolute-level and envelope agreement and by the mapped 104.7→211.5-Hz structure. Fixed band boundaries make the shifted Q01 appear richer at 100–500 Hz and should not be mistaken for an unrelated spectral shape.
